title: The Lighthouse
intro: Storm tonight. The great light on the cliff is dark, and every ship on this coast is sailing at the rocks. Someone has to climb up there and light it.

cove.name: Wrecker's Cove
cove.desc: Salt spray and black rocks. Rowboat stove-in. Boardwalk north, strand east, boathouse west, a cleft south.

actions.label: wait for rescue
fx: You huddle by the wreck till dawn. No rescue comes; out past the point, timbers split on the reef all night.

cove_sump.name: Cove Sump
cove_sump.desc: Under the stove-in rowboat. One rib is tarred to the keel.

actions.label: scrape the rib
fx: Old tar. They packed it before the last gale and never launched.

cleft.name: Smugglers' Cleft
cleft.desc: A slit in the rock, wet to the knee. Tide-marks are cut into the wall.

actions.label: read the tide-marks
fx: High water at the third nick. Tonight is higher.

cleft_ridge.name: Cleft Ridge
cleft_ridge.desc: A wet overhang above the slit. Silt is packed in a crack.

actions.label: pinch the silt
fx: Wet silt. The last high water left it.

cleft_ledge.name: Cleft Ledge
cleft_ledge.desc: A wet ledge west of the slit. Green slime packs a crack.

actions.label: thumb the slime
fx: Cold. They sat here counting boats and left the slime to take the stone.

cleft_nook.name: Cleft Nook
cleft_nook.desc: A dry elbow in the slit. One nick is packed with tar.

actions.label: scrape the nick
fx: Old tar. They marked the flood line and never came back.

tide_pool.name: Tide Pool
tide_pool.desc: A basin in the cleft floor, still as a glass. Tonight's flood will fill it twice.

actions.label: cup the water
fx: Brine. The nick on the wall is already wet.

tide_ridge.name: Tide Ridge
tide_ridge.desc: A wet ledge above the basin. Scum is packed in a crack.

actions.label: pinch the scum
fx: Dry scum. The pool dropped and left it on the ledge.

tide_sump.name: Tide Sump
tide_sump.desc: A wet drain under the basin. Muck is packed in a crack.

actions.label: pinch the muck
fx: Wet muck. The pool leaked through and they left it.

tide_nook.name: Tide Nook
tide_nook.desc: A wet pocket west of the basin. Foam is packed in a crack.

actions.label: pinch the foam
fx: Dry foam. The last flood left it when the pool dropped.

tide_sill.name: Tide Sill
tide_sill.desc: A wet sill south of the basin. Brine salt is packed in a crack.

actions.label: pinch the brine
fx: Dry salt. The pool dried back and left it.

tide_lip.name: Tide Lip
tide_lip.desc: A wet lip east of the basin. Kelp is packed in a crack.

actions.label: pinch the kelp
fx: Wet kelp. The last flood rammed it in and left it.

cache.name: Smugglers' Cache
cache.desc: A dry pocket above the high-water nick. One crate, empty except for straw.

actions.label: stir the straw
fx: Nothing left but the smell of brandy.

cache_sump.name: Cache Sump
cache_sump.desc: A dry drain under the crate. Lees are packed in a crack.

actions.label: pinch the lees
fx: Dry lees. A keg wept here and they packed the rest.

cache_nook.name: Cache Nook
cache_nook.desc: A dry pocket north of the crate. A slat is packed in a crack.

actions.label: pinch the slat
fx: Split oak. They hid this spare behind the crate.

cache_lip.name: Cache Lip
cache_lip.desc: A dry lip west of the crate. A crate slat is packed in a crack.

actions.label: pinch the crate
fx: Dry slat. They wedged it after the crate split.

cache_sill.name: Cache Sill
cache_sill.desc: A dry sill south of the crate. Straw is packed in a crack.

actions.label: pinch the straw
fx: Dry straw. They stuffed it in to keep the damp out.

keg_bung.name: Keg Bung
keg_bung.desc: The crate's last keg, dry. A bung still seats in the head.

actions.label: twist the bung
fx: It turns. The last keg went out on a spring tide.

keg_sump.name: Keg Sump
keg_sump.desc: A dry drain under the keg. A spare tap is packed in a crack.

actions.label: pinch the tap
fx: Brass tap. They meant to draw the last keg and left it.

keg_ridge.name: Keg Ridge
keg_ridge.desc: A dry ridge above the keg. A spare peg is packed in a crack.

actions.label: pinch the peg
fx: Oak peg. They meant to tap the last keg and left it.

keg_nook.name: Keg Nook
keg_nook.desc: A dry pocket north of the keg. A chime is packed in a crack.

actions.label: pinch the chime
fx: Oak chime. They split a hoop and packed the rim.

keg_sill.name: Keg Sill
keg_sill.desc: A dry sill south of the keg. The keg head is packed in a crack.

actions.label: pinch the head
fx: Split oak. They cut a spare head and packed it.

keg_lip.name: Keg Lip
keg_lip.desc: A dry lip east of the keg. Pitch is packed in a crack.

actions.label: pinch the pitch
fx: Hard pitch. They sealed the last leak and left it.

boathouse.name: Boathouse
boathouse.desc: A listing shed. One dory left; a brass speaking-trumpet on the thwart.

actions.label: bail the dory
fx: You throw the water out. No one is coming by sea tonight.

boat_ridge.name: Boat Ridge
boat_ridge.desc: The shed's ridge. One rafter ticks in the wind.

actions.label: rap the ridge
fx: Hollow. The thatch never sat right after the last gale.

dory_sump.name: Dory Sump
dory_sump.desc: The dory's lowest plank. Silt pools in the seam.

actions.label: cup the silt
fx: Cold grit. No one bailed this far down.

dory_keel.name: Dory Keel
dory_keel.desc: The dory's south keel. One transom nail is proud.

actions.label: rap the transom
fx: Solid. She would have held if anyone had launched.

thole_pin.name: Thole Pin
thole_pin.desc: The dory's port thole is empty. One pin lies in the bilge.

actions.label: seat the thole
fx: It seats. The last dory left with one pin missing.

oar_loft.name: Oar Loft
oar_loft.desc: Spare oars in a rack, one split. A cork fender hangs from a nail.

actions.label: lash the cork fender
fx: If a boat lives, it will not stave on the first knock.

oar_ridge.name: Oar Ridge
oar_ridge.desc: Boards over the oar rack. A leather wrap is packed in a crack.

actions.label: pinch the leather
fx: It holds. They wrapped a split loom and left the rest.

oar_nook.name: Oar Nook
oar_nook.desc: A dry pocket north of the rack. One oar loom is packed with tar.

actions.label: pinch the loom
fx: Split under the tar. They hid the break.

oar_sump.name: Oar Sump
oar_sump.desc: Under the rack. One split blade is packed with dried tar.

actions.label: scrape the blade
fx: They tarred the split and never replaced the oar.

rowlock.name: Rowlock
rowlock.desc: A spare bronze rowlock on a peg. The horn is bent from a bad pull.

actions.label: twist the horn
fx: It will not true. They left it rather than lose the oar.

paint_locker.name: Paint Locker
paint_locker.desc: Tins of red lead, most rusted shut. One lid still turns.

actions.label: turn a tin lid
fx: The lead is still wet at the heart. You close it.

brush_rack.name: Brush Rack
brush_rack.desc: Stiff brushes hung by size. One still holds red lead.

actions.label: wipe a brush
fx: Red on your thumb. The hulls were painted here, not at sea.

rag_tin.name: Rag Tin
rag_tin.desc: A tin of paint rags, stiff with red lead. One still gives.

actions.label: wring a rag
fx: Lead dust. They painted the channel marks from here.

turps.name: Turpentine Can
turps.desc: A dented can of turps, the cap stuck. The smell still bites.

actions.label: loosen the cap
fx: It turns a thread. The fumes are old. No thinning tonight.

funnel.name: Paint Funnel
funnel.desc: A tin funnel, gummed shut. A drop of red lead still hangs.

actions.label: tilt the funnel
fx: The drop does not fall. The lead dried years ago.

stopper.name: Stopper Jar
stopper.desc: A jar of corks. One is still wet with turps.

actions.label: squeeze the cork
fx: It weeps. Someone meant to thin a last tin and never did.

drip_tray.name: Drip Tray
drip_tray.desc: A tin tray under the jar. One drop of turps has gummed it.

actions.label: scrape the drop
fx: It flakes. The tray caught years of thinning, then nothing.

palette_knife.name: Palette Knife
palette_knife.desc: A palette knife stuck to the tray. The blade is gummed.

actions.label: peel the knife
fx: It comes. Red lead under the blade. No mixing tonight.

strand.name: Wreck Strand
strand.desc: Ribs of a brig in the surf. A watertight flare case is jammed in the kelp.

strand_ridge.name: Strand Ridge
strand_ridge.desc: A rock ridge above the kelp. Weed is packed in a crack.

actions.label: pinch the weed
fx: Wet weed. Storm packed it into the crack.

strand_lip.name: Strand Lip
strand_lip.desc: A rock lip north of the kelp. One bladder is packed in the weed.

actions.label: pinch the bladder
fx: Air still in it. The tide left it and did not take it back.

strand_sump.name: Strand Sump
strand_sump.desc: A hollow under the kelp. One glass shard is packed in the sand.

actions.label: pinch the shard
fx: Glass from a spent case. Someone fired too soon and left the rest.

brig_stem.name: Brig Stem
brig_stem.desc: The brig's name-board, half buried: HESTER. The letters still take a thumb.

actions.label: trace the name HESTER
fx: Hester. You say it once into the wind.

cutwater.name: Cutwater
cutwater.desc: The brig's leading edge, copper-sheathed, packed with wet sand.

actions.label: thumb the copper
fx: Cold. They sheathed her for ice, not a grave on this strand.

wreck_cabin.name: Wreck Cabin
wreck_cabin.desc: Half a cabin in the kelp. A ship's bell, cracked, hangs by a nail.

actions.label: toll the cracked bell
fx: A dead note. The drowned sailor nods once.

cabin_beam.name: Cabin Beam
cabin_beam.desc: A rafter over the wreck cabin. One beam is salt-split.

actions.label: tap the rafter
fx: It rings. The cabin held until the kelp pulled it down.

bulkhead.name: Bulkhead
bulkhead.desc: A sprung plank in the cabin's north wall. Oakum leaks from the seam.

actions.label: rap the plank
fx: Hollow. The next compartment is flooded.

porthole.name: Porthole
porthole.desc: A brass-rimmed eye in the wreck. Kelp presses the glass from outside.

actions.label: wipe the glass
fx: Green water. The cabin flooded from this side.

binnacle.name: Binnacle
binnacle.desc: The brig's compass, glass starred, card still free in the bowl.

actions.label: spin the card
fx: It sticks. She was heading south when she struck.

hold.name: Brig Hold
hold.desc: Knee-deep water. A drowned crate of candles, wax white as bone.

actions.label: salvage a handful of wax
fx: Useless in this rain. You pocket it anyway.

hold_stoop.name: Hold Stoop
hold_stoop.desc: A wet step south of the crate. Oak is packed in a plank seam.

actions.label: scrape the plank
fx: Wet oak. They packed this seam after a leak.

hold_lip.name: Hold Lip
hold_lip.desc: A frame-lip north of the hold. One oak splinter is packed in the seam.

actions.label: pinch the oak
fx: It holds. They drove the splinter in to stop a weep and left it.

hold_nook.name: Hold Nook
hold_nook.desc: A dry pocket in the frames. One trenail is packed in the oak.

actions.label: twist the trenail
fx: It turns half a turn. They drove it wet and never came back to set it.

rib_knee.name: Rib Knee
rib_knee.desc: A hanging knee against the hold's rib. Oak, still sound under the slime.

actions.label: tap the knee
fx: Solid. She would have made another voyage.

keelson.name: Keelson
keelson.desc: The spine of the brig, wet oak. A copper bolt is proud.

actions.label: twist the copper bolt
fx: It turns a finger. The wood holds. She was built to last.

bilge.name: Bilge
bilge.desc: The lowest wet. A pump handle stands in the dark.

actions.label: work the pump
fx: A cough of black water. The brig still leaks.

strum_box.name: Strum Box
strum_box.desc: A grate over the suction. Weed clogs the slots.

actions.label: clear the grate
fx: Weed comes away. The pump will draw now.

limber.name: Limber Hole
limber.desc: A drain cut in the floor timber. Silt has packed it shut.

actions.label: probe the silt
fx: A copper washer. You leave it. The drain stays packed.

scupper.name: Scupper
scupper.desc: A scupper cut in the hull. Salt crust around the lip.

actions.label: scrape the crust
fx: Old brine. The brig took water here long before tonight.

hull_plate.name: Hull Plate
hull_plate.desc: A sprung hull plate. One rivet still turns.

actions.label: press the rivet
fx: It turns. The plate stays sprung. The brig is done.

wharf.name: Old Wharf
wharf.desc: Rotten planks and tarred nets. Tavern east, cliff stair west, a chapel north.

actions.label: coil the spare lines
fx: The coils sit ready if a boat should live.

wharf_sump.name: Wharf Sump
wharf_sump.desc: Under the planks. One pile is tarred to the waterline.

actions.label: scrape the pile
fx: Old tar. They packed it before the last winter and never came back.

net_loft.name: Net Loft
net_loft.desc: Tar and hemp. An old net-mender sits among the piles, splicing by lamplight.

actions.label: splice a spare warp
fx: The splice will hold. You leave it for whoever comes after.

actions.label: look out the hatch
fx: Chapel roof, dark tower, unlit glass.

net_ridge.name: Net Ridge
net_ridge.desc: Rafters over the loft. Tar is packed in a ridge crack.

actions.label: pinch the tar
fx: It smears. He daubed this on a splice and left the rest.

net_sill.name: Net Sill
net_sill.desc: A sill south of the loft. One length of twine is packed in the tar.

actions.label: pinch the twine
fx: Sticky tar. He meant this for a splice.

net_nook.name: Net Nook
net_nook.desc: A dry pocket in the loft. One cork float is packed in the twine.

actions.label: pinch the float
fx: Light and dry. He kept it for the next net and never sewed it in.

hemp_bin.name: Hemp Bin
hemp_bin.desc: A slatted bin of spare hemp. One strand hangs over the rim, half-teased.

actions.label: tease a strand
fx: It unlays clean. He kept this for the next splice.

fid_rack.name: Fid Rack
fid_rack.desc: A row of splicing fids, lignum vitae, one missing from the last hole.

actions.label: draw a fid
fx: Tapered lignum. He left it in the last splice and never came back.

tavern.name: The Bell & Anchor
tavern.desc: Low beams, peat smoke, one lamp. The innkeep polishes a glass and watches the weather-glass fall.

actions.label: drink a tot of grog
fx: The grog burns. Some warmth returns.

tavern_porch.name: Tavern Porch
tavern_porch.desc: A salt-wet rail south of the door. One slat is loose.

actions.label: wipe the rail
fx: Grit and tar. They stood here watching the weather-glass fall.

spittoon.name: Spittoon
spittoon.desc: A brass spittoon under the east settle. It has not been emptied.

actions.label: nudge the tin
fx: Heavy. They stopped emptying it when the storm closed the door.

inn_room.name: Innkeep's Room
inn_room.desc: A narrow bunk. The window looks on the reef. Oilskins drip on a peg.

actions.label: watch the reef from the window
fx: A schooner's lights, too close. The tower is still dark.

inn_stoop.name: Inn Stoop
inn_stoop.desc: The south threshold. One tread is clay-caked.

actions.label: scrape the tread
fx: Boot-clay. He came up from the cliff path and did not wipe.

inn_loft.name: Inn Loft
inn_loft.desc: A crawlspace over the bunk. One lath is sprung.

actions.label: tap the lath
fx: Hollow. He hid nothing up here but dust.

peg_rail.name: Peg Rail
peg_rail.desc: A row of pegs above the bunk. One hook is bent from a heavy coat.

actions.label: straighten the peg
fx: It springs back. He hung his oilskin here in worse weather.

window_latch.name: Window Latch
window_latch.desc: The reef-window's iron catch, wet with spray. It has not been thrown tonight.

actions.label: throw the catch
fx: It holds. The storm is in the glass, not the frame.

washstand.name: Washstand
washstand.desc: A cracked ewer and a slop-bowl. Rain has filled the ewer from the leak.

linen.name: Linen Shelf
linen.desc: Folded sheets, salt-stiff. A nightshirt on a peg.

actions.label: shake the nightshirt
fx: Sand falls out. She slept in her clothes when the glass dropped.

mending.name: Mending Basket
mending.desc: Torn cuffs in a willow basket. A needle is stuck in the rim.

actions.label: thread the needle
fx: The eye is empty. She mended by feel in the dark.

darning.name: Darning Box
darning.desc: A box of wool scraps. One sock is half-mended, the needle gone.

actions.label: tug the yarn
fx: It parts. She stopped mid-stitch when the glass dropped.

thimble.name: Thimble Cup
thimble.desc: A brass thimble on its side. A pin is stuck through the rim.

actions.label: draw the pin
fx: Bent. She used it as a tack, not a thimble.

button_box.name: Button Box
button_box.desc: A tin of loose buttons. One still has thread through the shank.

actions.label: roll the button
fx: Bone, not horn. The rest are horn. One Sunday shirt.

snuff_tin.name: Snuff Tin
snuff_tin.desc: A dented snuff tin. The lid is jammed.

actions.label: work the lid
fx: It pops. Empty. She took the last pinch years ago.

oiled_paper.name: Oiled Paper
oiled_paper.desc: A square of oiled paper under the tin. The crease still holds.

actions.label: unfold the paper
fx: A pinch-print. She kept it for the gallery watch.

snuff_spoon.name: Snuff Spoon
snuff_spoon.desc: A tiny spoon under the paper. The bowl is black.

actions.label: wipe the bowl
fx: Tobacco stain. She took it to the gallery and never brought it back.

cellar.name: Tavern Cellar
cellar.desc: Barrels and a locked sea-chest. The storm comes down the hatch as a wet breath.

actions.label: pry the sea-chest
fx: The lid gives. Rusted keys, a brass button. Nothing that opens the tower.

cellar_stoop.name: Cellar Stoop
cellar_stoop.desc: A step south of the barrels. Mortar is packed in a flag.

actions.label: scrape the flag
fx: Dry mortar. They reset this flag after the last flood.

cellar_nook.name: Cellar Nook
cellar_nook.desc: A dry pocket north of the chest. One brick sits proud of the mortar.

actions.label: thumb the brick
fx: It seats. They patched the seep after the last flood and left it proud.

cellar_sump.name: Cellar Sump
cellar_sump.desc: A drain under the chest. One hoop-nail is packed in the silt.

actions.label: pinch the nail
fx: Bent iron. They mended a hoop down here and left the spare.

hasp_plate.name: Hasp Plate
hasp_plate.desc: The chest's spare hasp, nailed to a barrel-end. It never got fitted.

actions.label: work the hasp
fx: It yields. Empty. They took the last bottle up for the storm.

ice_pit.name: Ice Pit
ice_pit.desc: A sanded hole under the tavern. Last winter's ice is a black puddle.

actions.label: taste the melt
fx: Brackish. The storm has already come down here.

ice_ridge.name: Ice Ridge
ice_ridge.desc: A cold overhang above the pit. Frost is packed in a crack.

actions.label: pinch the frost
fx: It bites. Melt from the pit froze here overnight.

ice_sill.name: Ice Sill
ice_sill.desc: A sanded sill south of the pit. Last winter packed a crust of grit.

actions.label: scrape the sand
fx: Sawdust under the ice-sand. They packed it wet and never came back.

ice_sump.name: Ice Sump
ice_sump.desc: Under the puddle. One flake of last winter is packed in the sand.

actions.label: pinch the flake
fx: Grit and old ice. The pit was never drained after the thaw.

ice_pick.name: Ice Pick
ice_pick.desc: A pick hung for the last block. The point is blunted from the floor.

actions.label: test the pick
fx: Too dull. The last ice went out in April.

pick_sump.name: Pick Sump
pick_sump.desc: A dry drain under the pick. A spare tang is packed in a crack.

actions.label: pinch the tang
fx: Iron tang. They meant to rehaft the pick and left it.

pick_ridge.name: Pick Ridge
pick_ridge.desc: A dry ridge above the pick. A spare ferrule is packed in a crack.

actions.label: pinch the ferrule
fx: Iron ferrule. They meant to bind the split haft and left it.

pick_sill.name: Pick Sill
pick_sill.desc: A dry sill west of the pick. A spare wrap is packed in a crack.

actions.label: pinch the wrap
fx: Cloth wrap. They kept a spare after the haft split.

pick_lip.name: Pick Lip
pick_lip.desc: A dry lip east of the pick. A haft wrap is packed in a crack.

actions.label: pinch the haft
fx: Worn wrap. They bound the split haft and left the spare.

pick_nook.name: Pick Nook
pick_nook.desc: A dry pocket north of the pick. A burr is packed in a crack.

actions.label: pinch the burr
fx: Iron burr. They blunted the pick on the floor and left this.

ice_tongs.name: Ice Tongs
ice_tongs.desc: Iron tongs hang on a peg. The jaws are frozen open.

actions.label: close the jaws
fx: They bite. Empty. The last block was sold in spring.

sawdust_bin.name: Sawdust Bin
sawdust_bin.desc: A bin of sawdust for packing ice. One board is loose.

actions.label: lift the board
fx: Mice again. They nested here when the ice was gone.

packing_straw.name: Packing Straw
packing_straw.desc: A bale of packing straw. One band is cut.

actions.label: tug the band
fx: It parts. The ice left with the last cart.

ice_saw.name: Ice Saw
ice_saw.desc: A saw hung for cutting blocks. The teeth are packed with sawdust.

actions.label: rap the teeth
fx: Dust falls. No ice has been cut since March.

ice_hook.name: Ice Hook
ice_hook.desc: An ice-hook on a nail. The point is blunt.

actions.label: test the point
fx: Blunt. They dragged blocks, they did not spear them.

block_mold.name: Block Mold
block_mold.desc: A wooden mold for ice blocks. One slat is sprung.

actions.label: press the slat
fx: It springs back. The last block stuck and they split the mold.

drag_chain.name: Drag Chain
drag_chain.desc: A short chain for dragging ice. One link is open.

actions.label: close the link
fx: It will not seat. The open link hauled the last block up.

haul_bar.name: Haul Bar
haul_bar.desc: A haul-bar through the last link. The wood is polished.

actions.label: twist the bar
fx: Worn smooth. They hauled by hand when the horse was sold.

ice_sled.name: Ice Sled
ice_sled.desc: A sled for ice blocks. One runner is split.

actions.label: rock the runner
fx: It splits further. They dragged the last load, they did not sled it.

chapel.name: St. Elmo's Chapel
chapel.desc: A squat stone chapel. Storm-bell in the belfry; graves east.

actions.label: ring the storm-bell
fx: The bell carries out to sea.

actions.label: kneel for the ships
fx: Salt on your lips. You get up.

chapel_cellar.name: Chapel Cellar
chapel_cellar.desc: A damp undercroft. One flag is loose.

actions.label: tap the flag
fx: Hollow. They hid nothing. The drowned keep the rest.

chapel_loft.name: Chapel Loft
chapel_loft.desc: Boards under the belfry. One bell-rope hangs from a peg.

actions.label: pluck the rope
fx: Dust. The storm-bell's twin never hung.

lectern.name: Lectern
lectern.desc: Oak stand, a drowned-name list pinned under a stone. One leaf is turned.

actions.label: turn a leaf
fx: Hester, and two more. You leave it open.

vestry.name: Vestry
vestry.desc: Damp cassocks. A row of votive stubs waits on the press.

actions.label: light a votive
fx: A small flame for the drowned.

vestry_loft.name: Vestry Loft
vestry_loft.desc: A shelf of spare cassocks. One cuff is salt-stiff.

actions.label: thumb the cassock
fx: Damp wool. They hung it wet after the last burial.

vestry_stoop.name: Vestry Stoop
vestry_stoop.desc: A stone step south of the vestry. Salt has eaten one edge.

actions.label: scrape the step
fx: White grit. They tracked it in from the graves and never swept.

prie_dieu.name: Prie-Dieu
prie_dieu.desc: A worn kneeler facing a blank wall. The cushion is salt-stiff.

actions.label: press the cushion
fx: Hard as board. No one has knelt here since Maren.

stoup.name: Stoup
stoup.desc: A stone basin by the vestry door. The water is gone; a salt ring remains.

actions.label: touch the rim
fx: A dry ring of salt. No one filled it for Sunday.

crypt.name: Chapel Crypt
crypt.desc: Low vault, salt in the mortar. One niche is empty.

actions.label: bow at the empty niche
fx: Whoever lay here is gone to sea.

crypt_stoop.name: Crypt Stoop
crypt_stoop.desc: A flagstone south of the vault. Grit is packed in a joint.

actions.label: scrape the joint
fx: Dry grit. They tracked it down from the graves.

crypt_nook.name: Crypt Nook
crypt_nook.desc: A dry pocket in the north vault. Salt has packed the mortar.

actions.label: thumb the mortar
fx: It gives. They laid this in a hurry after the last burial.

crypt_sump.name: Crypt Sump
crypt_sump.desc: A drain under the vault. One bone chip is packed in the grit.

actions.label: pinch the chip
fx: Salt-white. Whoever lay above left a piece of the vault.

pall_ring.name: Pall Ring
pall_ring.desc: An iron ring in the east wall, meant to hang a pall. The cloth is gone.

actions.label: turn the ring
fx: It grates. They took the pall when they took the body.

ossuary.name: Ossuary
ossuary.desc: Shelved bones, salt-white. One skull wears a keeper's cap.

actions.label: tip the keeper's cap
fx: The skull does not mind. The cap stays.

reliquary.name: Reliquary
reliquary.desc: A shelf of bottles, each labelled in Latin. One is uncorked.

actions.label: cork the open bottle
fx: The smell is salt, not wine. You cork it.

censer.name: Censer Niche
censer.desc: A brass censer on a hook, cold. Ash cakes the bowl.

actions.label: tap the bowl
fx: Ash falls. Frankincense once. Tonight the chapel is unlit.

char_pan.name: Char Pan
char_pan.desc: A pan of spent charcoal under the censer. One lump is whole.

ash_rake.name: Ash Rake
ash_rake.desc: A small rake against the pan. Ash cakes the tines.

actions.label: shake the tines
fx: Ash falls. She raked after every watch.

match_tin.name: Match Tin
match_tin.desc: A tin of matches under the rake. One stick is unused.

actions.label: strike the stick
fx: The head crumbles. Dead sulphur. She never needed a second.

flint_box.name: Flint Box
flint_box.desc: A box of flint chips. One still has a spark-face.

actions.label: knap the flint
fx: It flakes. The last spark was for the censer, not the lamp.

churchyard.name: Churchyard
churchyard.desc: Wind-bitten stones. Maren's grave is the newest, the letters still sharp.

actions.label: read the grave-stone
fx: Maren Keepersdaughter. She kept the light.

grave_hood.name: Grave Hood
grave_hood.desc: A lichen cap on Maren's stone. One flake peels in the wind.

actions.label: pinch the lichen
fx: Dry and grey. No one has cleaned the letters since the burial.

grave_sump.name: Grave Sump
grave_sump.desc: A dip at Maren's foot. Grit sits in the cut.

actions.label: pinch the grit
fx: Salt and sand. They never finished packing the foot.

grave_vase.name: Grave Vase
grave_vase.desc: A zinc vase at Maren's headstone. Last year's stems are grey.

actions.label: tilt the vase
fx: Dry. No one has brought water since the burial.

lych_gate.name: Lych Gate
lych_gate.desc: The churchyard's south gate, unlatched since the last burial. Salt has swollen the oak.

actions.label: lift the latch
fx: It sticks. The last funeral went through and no one oiled it.

sexton_hut.name: Sexton's Hut
sexton_hut.desc: A one-room hut. A kettle, cold. A prayer-book open to the drowned.

actions.label: read the prayer for the drowned
fx: Lord of the deep, take them gentle.

sexton_cellar.name: Sexton Cellar
sexton_cellar.desc: A dirt hole under the hut. One pottery shard sits in the packed earth.

actions.label: pick the shard
fx: A cup-rim. He buried the rest when the bell rang.

sexton_loft.name: Sexton Loft
sexton_loft.desc: A loft over the hut. One thatch-end hangs in.

actions.label: pinch the thatch
fx: Dry. He patched this after the last gale.

bead_string.name: Bead String
bead_string.desc: A broken rosary on a nail. Three beads remain.

actions.label: count the beads
fx: Three. He stopped praying when the bell rang.

kettle_lid.name: Kettle Lid
kettle_lid.desc: The sexton's kettle, cold. The lid sits crooked on the rim.

actions.label: rap the lid
fx: Hollow. He left the fire when the bell rang.

woodpile.name: Woodpile
woodpile.desc: Split oak under a tarpaulin. One log is dry enough to take a spark.

actions.label: restack the wood
fx: The dry log sits on top now.

chopping_block.name: Chopping Block
chopping_block.desc: A stump scored by the axe. The head is buried in the wood.

actions.label: work the axe
fx: One split. Dry oak. Kindling for a night that never came.

sawhorse.name: Sawhorse
sawhorse.desc: A sawhorse and a rusty saw. Oak dust on the ground.

actions.label: draw the saw
fx: It sings once. The tooth is still set.

wood_shed.name: Wood Shed
wood_shed.desc: Dry sticks under a leaky roof. A wedge of oak is stuck in the wall.

actions.label: pull the oak wedge
fx: It comes. Kindling. You leave it for the next keeper.

kindling_bin.name: Kindling Bin
kindling_bin.desc: A crate of split twigs. One bundle is tied with twine.

actions.label: untie the bundle
fx: Dry enough. Maren stacked these for a night like this.

drip_pail.name: Drip Pail
drip_pail.desc: A tin pail catching the leak. The roof ticks.

actions.label: empty the pail
fx: A pint of roof-water. You pour it out.

tar_pot.name: Tar Pot
tar_pot.desc: A cold pot of roof-tar. A stick is frozen in it.

actions.label: twist the stick
fx: It comes. The tar is dead. The leak will wait.

shingle_stack.name: Shingle Stack
shingle_stack.desc: A stack of cedar shingles, warped. One is still true.

actions.label: lift a shingle
fx: Dry on the underside. Enough to patch the leak.

keeper_cottage.name: Keeper's Cottage
keeper_cottage.desc: Dust sheets, a cold hearth, charts of the reef pinned to every wall. Something pale waits by the window.

actions.label: light the hearth with the tinderbox
fx: Peat catches. The room is almost kind.

actions.label: study the reef charts
fx: The inner channel is a knife. Aim the beam south.

cottage_nook.name: Cottage Nook
cottage_nook.desc: A nook north of the hearth. One slate loose in the wall.

actions.label: lift the slate
fx: Blank. She kept a spare key here once.

cottage_cellar.name: Cottage Cellar
cottage_cellar.desc: A low cellar under the hearth. Cold ash on the flags.

actions.label: rake the ash
fx: Grey. She let the fire die the night she left.

peat_crate.name: Peat Crate
peat_crate.desc: A crate of peat by the west wall. One brick is split.

actions.label: split a brick
fx: Dry at the core. She saved this for a night like this.

peat_lid.name: Peat Lid
peat_lid.desc: A board over the crate. One cap-nail is proud.

actions.label: seat the cap
fx: It seats. She nailed this shut after the last cut.

peat_wall.name: Peat Wall
peat_wall.desc: The crate's west face. One stave is proud of the rest.

actions.label: press the stave
fx: It seats. She packed this crate after the last cut.

peat_pit.name: Peat Pit
peat_pit.desc: The crate's floor. One pinch of dust still sits.

actions.label: pinch the dust
fx: Dry. She never swept this after the last cut.

peat_edge.name: Peat Edge
peat_edge.desc: The crate's north rim. One crumb of peat.

actions.label: brush the crumb
fx: Dry. She stacked this for a winter that did not come.

peat_slat.name: Peat Slat
peat_slat.desc: A slat on the crate's south face. One board is sprung.

actions.label: flex the slat
fx: It springs. She nailed this crate shut after the last cut.

attic.name: Keeper's Attic
attic.desc: Dust, a trunk, a cracked spyglass on the sill.

actions.label: glass the reef
fx: A schooner yaws. The beam would have saved her.

ridge_vent.name: Ridge Vent
ridge_vent.desc: A gap in the ridge. Wind, no light.

actions.label: feel the draft
fx: Cold. The beam would have cut this gale.

dormer_sill.name: Dormer Sill
dormer_sill.desc: The south dormer. Salt on the sill. The pane is cracked.

actions.label: wipe the sill
fx: Salt. She watched the reef from here, not the glass.

rafter_nail.name: Rafter Nail
rafter_nail.desc: A bent nail in the ridge beam. A scrap of oilskin hangs from it.

actions.label: twist the nail
fx: It turns. She hung the spare glass here in the last gale.

wick_box.name: Wick Box
wick_box.desc: A cedar box under the eaves. Spare lamp-wicks, counted in pencil on the lid.

actions.label: count the wicks
fx: Six left. Enough for a week if the glass stays dry.

trunk_nook.name: Trunk Nook
trunk_nook.desc: Maren's sea-trunk, the hasp already sprung. A folded oilskin lining.

actions.label: fold the oilskin lining
fx: Dry enough to wrap a wick. You leave it.

chart_tube.name: Chart Tube
chart_tube.desc: A tin tube in the trunk's lid. One chart, rolled tight, pencil on the back.

actions.label: unroll the chart
fx: A pencil channel. South of the reef, twice underlined.

garden.name: Keeper's Garden
garden.desc: Salt-killed herbs. A rain-butt leans under the eaves.

trellis.name: Trellis
trellis.desc: A lean trellis over the beds. One lath is loose.

actions.label: seat the lath
fx: It seats. She grew beans here before the salt took them.

compost.name: Compost
compost.desc: A heap by the beds. Dry, no heat.

actions.label: turn the heap
fx: Cold. She stopped turning it when the beds went to seed.

cold_frame.name: Cold Frame
cold_frame.desc: A cracked glass pane over last year's soil. Nothing greened.

actions.label: lift the pane
fx: Sour earth. She gave up on the garden the winter before.

well.name: Cottage Well
well.desc: A stone well, the bucket half-drowned. The rope is sound.

actions.label: haul the bucket
fx: Rainwater, clean enough. You let it down again.

well_apron.name: Well Apron
well_apron.desc: A lime apron south of the well. One flake of mortar.

actions.label: chip the lime
fx: It flakes. She pointed this the summer before the drought.

well_silt.name: Well Silt
well_silt.desc: Silt at the well floor. One dry pebble.

actions.label: thumb the pebble
fx: Dry. The well gave out the year the horse left.

well_lid.name: Well Lid
well_lid.desc: A warped lid on the well-head. One board split.

actions.label: lift the lid
fx: It lifts. She never covered the well after the drought.

well_crank.name: Well Crank
well_crank.desc: The iron crank on the well-head. One handle is bent.

actions.label: turn the crank
fx: It groans. The rope still runs true.

trough.name: Horse Trough
trough.desc: A stone trough, empty. Moss in the grain. No horse has drunk here in years.

actions.label: wipe the moss
fx: A date under the moss: 1861. Maren's first year.

trough_foot.name: Trough Foot
trough_foot.desc: A drain under the trough. Packed silt.

actions.label: pick the silt
fx: Dry. She never filled it after the horse went.

pump_arm.name: Pump Arm
pump_arm.desc: A rusted pump over the trough. Handle frozen.

actions.label: lift the arm
fx: Stuck. She never pumped after the horse went.

hitch_ring.name: Hitch Ring
hitch_ring.desc: An iron ring set in the west stone. Rusted. No rope.

actions.label: rattle the ring
fx: It holds. The last horse was tied here in '79.

trough_bung.name: Trough Bung
trough_bung.desc: A bung hole in the trough's east end. The bung sits half out.

actions.label: seat the bung
fx: It seats. The trough would hold water if a horse still came.

paddock.name: Paddock
paddock.desc: A fenced square of salt grass. Posts lean. No horse.

actions.label: count the posts
fx: Eight. One missing. Maren sold the last horse in '79.

post_hole.name: Post Hole
post_hole.desc: The ninth hole, empty. Salt crust on the rim.

actions.label: chip the crust
fx: Salt. The ninth post went with the horse.

salt_rail.name: Salt Rail
salt_rail.desc: The top rail of the paddock fence. White with salt.

actions.label: brush the salt
fx: The horse used to do this. Gone since '79.

missing_post.name: Missing Post
missing_post.desc: A hole where the ninth post stood. The stub is rotten.

actions.label: kick the stub
fx: It crumbles. She sold the post with the horse.

fence_wire.name: Fence Wire
fence_wire.desc: A slack strand of wire on the west posts. One barb is still sharp.

actions.label: pluck the wire
fx: It twangs. The gap is where the missing post stood.

stable.name: Empty Stable
stable.desc: One stall. The manger is clean. A bridle hook is empty.

actions.label: touch the bridle hook
fx: Worn smooth. The horse left in '79. The hook stayed.

stall_drain.name: Stall Drain
stall_drain.desc: A drain in the stall floor. Straw, no water.

actions.label: poke the grate
fx: Dry. She never watered the stall after.

hay_loft.name: Hay Loft
hay_loft.desc: A loft over the stall. One wisp of hay on the hatch.

actions.label: toss a wisp
fx: Dust. The last bale went with the horse.

hay_fork.name: Hay Fork
hay_fork.desc: A three-tine fork leaning on the north wall. Dry hay on one tine.

actions.label: lift the fork
fx: Light. The last hay went with the horse.

manger_rail.name: Manger Rail
manger_rail.desc: The stall's west rail, chewed smooth. One tooth-mark still shows.

actions.label: rub the chew
fx: Bay teeth. The sold horse cribbed here.

tack_room.name: Tack Room
tack_room.desc: Pegs and empty shelves. A curry-comb hangs on a nail.

actions.label: lift the curry-comb
fx: Hair in the teeth. Bay, not grey. The sold horse.

tack_loft.name: Tack Loft
tack_loft.desc: Rafters over the tack room. One nail holds a folded numnah.

actions.label: lift the numnah
fx: Dust. She packed this the morning the horse left.

tack_crack.name: Tack Crack
tack_crack.desc: A floorboard crack under the tack room. One knot is proud.

actions.label: thumb the crack
fx: Hair. Bay, same as the comb. The sold horse shed here.

girth_peg.name: Girth Peg
girth_peg.desc: A peg on the south wall. One girth hangs slack.

actions.label: seat the girth
fx: It seats. She oiled this the morning the horse left.

bit_hook.name: Bit Hook
bit_hook.desc: A hook on the north wall. One snaffle bit hangs.

actions.label: hang the bit
fx: It seats. The sold horse left this behind.

bin_rim.name: Bin Rim
bin_rim.desc: The north rim of the oat bin. Chew marks on the lip.

actions.label: scrape the chew
fx: Wood. She never filled this after the sale.

feed_bin.name: Feed Bin
feed_bin.desc: An empty oat bin. A scoop hangs on a nail, the lip chewed.

actions.label: rattle the scoop
fx: A husk falls out. The sold horse ate here last.

bin_hatch.name: Bin Hatch
bin_hatch.desc: A hatch over the oat bin. One cover sits askew.

actions.label: lift the cover
fx: It lifts. She never latched this after the last fill.

oat_dregs.name: Oat Dregs
oat_dregs.desc: The bin's floor. One paste of husk still sticks.

actions.label: thumb the dregs
fx: Sour. She never scraped this after the sale.

bin_foot.name: Bin Foot
bin_foot.desc: The south foot of the oat bin. One husk stuck in a crack.

actions.label: pick the husk
fx: Dry. She never swept this after the sale.

oat_sack.name: Oat Sack
oat_sack.desc: A collapsed sack. Mice have chewed a hole in the seam.

actions.label: pinch the seam
fx: Empty. The mice finished what the horse left.

oat_floor.name: Oat Floor
oat_floor.desc: Boards under the sack. One hull is stuck in a crack.

actions.label: pick the hull
fx: Empty. The mice took every grain that fell.

sack_beam.name: Sack Beam
sack_beam.desc: A rafter over the sack. One beam is scored with teeth.

actions.label: rap the beam
fx: Hollow. She hung the spare sacks here before the sale.

oat_spill.name: Oat Spill
oat_spill.desc: Husks south of the sack. One handful still holds shape.

actions.label: lift the spill
fx: Dust. She swept this once, then left the rest.

sack_lip.name: Sack Lip
sack_lip.desc: The sack's north lip. One flap is still tied.

actions.label: fold the flap
fx: It folds. She tied this shut after the last feed.

mouse_run.name: Mouse Run
mouse_run.desc: A hole chewed in the skirting. Straw and husks spill out.

actions.label: listen at the hole
fx: Nothing. The mice left with the horse.

mouse_pit.name: Mouse Pit
mouse_pit.desc: A dip under the run. One dry pellet sits in the dust.

actions.label: pick the pellet
fx: Old. They left when the oats ran out.

mouse_loft.name: Mouse Loft
mouse_loft.desc: A gap over the run. One beam is chewed through.

actions.label: feel the beam
fx: Soft wood. They nested here after the oats ran out.

husk_trail.name: Husk Trail
husk_trail.desc: A trail of husks south of the run. One print still sharp.

actions.label: trace the husk
fx: Tiny feet. They left when the oats ran out.

gnaw_rail.name: Gnaw Rail
gnaw_rail.desc: The skirting north of the run. Teeth marks along the rail.

actions.label: feel the gnaw
fx: Fresh wood. They left when the oats ran out.

nest_nook.name: Nest Nook
nest_nook.desc: A mouse nest of chewed linen. One shred still holds a stitch.

actions.label: tease the shred
fx: Blue thread. The nightshirt's missing cuff.

nest_pit.name: Nest Pit
nest_pit.desc: A hollow under the nest. One pinch of packed dirt holds a hair.

actions.label: pinch the dirt
fx: A grey hair. She lined this after the nightshirt tore.

nest_loft.name: Nest Loft
nest_loft.desc: A shelf over the nest. One lint-clump hangs.

actions.label: thumb the lint
fx: Grey. They pulled it from the nightshirt hem.

nest_fluff.name: Nest Fluff
nest_fluff.desc: A scatter of down south of the nest. One pinch still holds.

actions.label: pinch the fluff
fx: Soft. She lined this after the nightshirt tore.

nest_rim.name: Nest Rim
nest_rim.desc: The nest's north rim. One tuft of linen still sits.

actions.label: lift the tuft
fx: The cuff's twin. She tore this lining for the nest.

straw_plug.name: Straw Plug
straw_plug.desc: A plug of straw in the hole. The run goes on behind it.

actions.label: pull the plug
fx: It comes. The run goes on into the wall.

herb_shed.name: Herb Shed
herb_shed.desc: Dried fennel and empty hooks. Maren kept the oil-stink out of the house with this.

actions.label: crush a fennel head
fx: The smell is clean. She used this against the oil-stink.

herb_loft.name: Herb Loft
herb_loft.desc: A loft over the shed. One fennel bundle hangs.

actions.label: pinch the bundle
fx: Dust. She hung this after the last harvest.

herb_bin.name: Herb Bin
herb_bin.desc: A bin under the bench. Dried stalks, no seed.

actions.label: sift the stalks
fx: Dry. The fennel went to the still.

drying_rack.name: Drying Rack
drying_rack.desc: Twine and last year's fennel, brittle as glass.

actions.label: snap a stem
fx: It dusts. Too old to hang. She never restocked.

seed_tin.name: Seed Tin
seed_tin.desc: A dented tin on the east hook. Fennel seed, or the dust of it.

actions.label: rattle the tin
fx: Empty but for dust. She took the last seed in spring.

still_room.name: Still Room
still_room.desc: A copper worm and a cold fire. Maren distilled something here besides oil.

actions.label: sniff the copper worm
fx: Anise and lamp-oil. She mixed them on purpose.

still_ash.name: Still Ash
still_ash.desc: Cold ash under the still. One black flake.

actions.label: crush the flake
fx: Soot. She let the fire die when the worm went cold.

still_vent.name: Still Vent
still_vent.desc: A vent over the worm. Soot on the lip.

actions.label: wipe the lip
fx: Anise soot. She ran it hot the last winter.

spirit_tap.name: Spirit Tap
spirit_tap.desc: A brass tap on the south cask. Dry. One drip of resin at the spout.

actions.label: turn the tap
fx: Air. The last run went into the jar on the north shelf.

spirit_jar.name: Spirit Jar
spirit_jar.desc: A sealed jar of last year's spirit. Wax over the cork, cracked.

actions.label: thumb the wax
fx: It gives. Anise under the seal. She corked this for winter.

worm_tub.name: Worm Tub
worm_tub.desc: A tub under the worm. One hoop is slack.

actions.label: seat the hoop
fx: It seats. The tub held mash once. Dry now.

mash_paddle.name: Mash Paddle
mash_paddle.desc: A mash paddle leaning in the tub. The blade is split.

actions.label: flex the blade
fx: It splits further. No mash has been stirred in years.

barm_crock.name: Barm Crock
barm_crock.desc: A crock of spent yeast. The lid sits ajar.

actions.label: sniff the barm
fx: Sour. The last mash went off before the wreck.

wort_pail.name: Wort Pail
wort_pail.desc: A pail that caught wort. A film of sugar remains.

actions.label: scrape the film
fx: It flakes. Sweet once. The still ran dry.

mash_stone.name: Mash Stone
mash_stone.desc: A grooved stone for crushing malt. One groove is packed.

actions.label: clear the groove
fx: Husks. The last malt was crushed for the still, not bread.

malt_riddle.name: Malt Riddle
malt_riddle.desc: A riddle for sifting malt. One mesh is torn.

actions.label: stretch the mesh
fx: It parts. They sifted the last malt by hand.

cliff_path.name: Cliff Stair
cliff_path.desc: A hundred worn steps, wind tearing at your coat. The lighthouse door is a black slab above.

actions.label: fire the signal flare
fx: Red fire arcs over the reef.

actions.label: hail the reef with the trumpet
fx: The brass bark carries. A helm-lamp answers once, then vanishes.

path_drop.name: Path Drop
path_drop.desc: A cracked step over the drop. One edge is loose.

actions.label: brace the step
fx: It holds. She marked this tread after a man went over.

path_nook.name: Path Nook
path_nook.desc: A cut in the north wall of the stair. One nick in the stone.

actions.label: trace the nick
fx: A bearing mark. She cut this on a clear night.

boot_scraper.name: Boot Scraper
boot_scraper.desc: An iron scraper at the stair's foot. Clay still packed in the teeth.

actions.label: scrape a boot
fx: Red clay. She came up from the churchyard last.

scraper_post.name: Scraper Post
scraper_post.desc: A post above the iron. One grip is worn smooth.

actions.label: grip the post
fx: Smooth. She held this while she scraped after the burial.

scraper_sump.name: Scraper Sump
scraper_sump.desc: A dip under the iron. One smear of mud still wet.

actions.label: thumb the mud
fx: Red still. She stood here after the burial and never wiped the iron.

grit_tray.name: Grit Tray
grit_tray.desc: A tin tray south of the scraper. One corner holds grit.

actions.label: knock the grit
fx: Churchyard grit. She never emptied this after the burial.

heel_iron.name: Heel Iron
heel_iron.desc: A second iron west of the scraper. One heel-bar is loose.

actions.label: press the iron
fx: It seats. She used this after the burial walk.

clay_pan.name: Clay Pan
clay_pan.desc: A clay pan east of the scraper. One lump packed hard.

actions.label: prise the clay
fx: It parts. She never cleaned the teeth after the burial.

headland.name: Headland
headland.desc: Grass laid flat by the wind. A wrecker's cairn marks the drop.

actions.label: set a stone on the cairn
fx: One more stone. The dead keep the count.

actions.label: listen to the drop
fx: Surf far below. A bell, maybe yours.

cairn_hood.name: Cairn Hood
cairn_hood.desc: A moss cap over the cairn. One stone peeks through.

actions.label: pinch the moss
fx: Wet and thin. They never finished packing the top.

cairn_sump.name: Cairn Sump
cairn_sump.desc: A wet hollow under the cairn. Sod is packed over the stones.

actions.label: press the sod
fx: Cold and tight. They packed it so the stones would stay.

headland_lip.name: Headland Lip
headland_lip.desc: The seaward lip. One turf-clump hangs over the drop.

actions.label: grip the turf
fx: It holds. They crawled here to watch for wrecks.

cairn_base.name: Cairn Base
cairn_base.desc: The windward foot of the cairn. Stones stacked without mortar, each a wreck.

actions.label: count the stones
fx: Forty-odd. One for each wreck they claimed.

wreck_post.name: Wrecker's Post
wreck_post.desc: A rotten timber post. A tarred flag hangs in rags.

actions.label: hoist the rag-flag
fx: The rag lifts and hangs. No one will see it in this rain.

fire_pit.name: Signal Pit
fire_pit.desc: A ring of blackened stones. Ash from a wrecker's fire, long cold.

actions.label: stir the cold ash
fx: No ember. Tonight the light has to come from the tower.

pit_sump.name: Pit Sump
pit_sump.desc: A dip under the ring. One black ember sits in the wet.

actions.label: thumb the ember
fx: Dead. They ran with the last heat and never came back.

pit_hood.name: Pit Hood
pit_hood.desc: A tin cowl over the pit. One flap is jammed open.

actions.label: lift the cowl
fx: Rain in. They left it open after the last fire.

ash_bucket.name: Ash Bucket
ash_bucket.desc: A dented bucket of last week's ash, set north of the pit to catch the wind.

actions.label: tip the bucket
fx: Grey dust. No heat left to carry to the tower.

torch_rest.name: Torch Rest
torch_rest.desc: A stone notch west of the pit, charred where a brand used to sit.

actions.label: seat the brand
fx: It would hold. They ran with the last torch and never came back.

torch_sump.name: Torch Sump
torch_sump.desc: A charred drain under the rest. Ash is packed in a crack.

actions.label: pinch the ash
fx: Cold ash. They swept the rest and packed it here.

torch_ridge.name: Torch Ridge
torch_ridge.desc: A charred ridge above the rest. An ember is packed in a crack.

actions.label: pinch the ember
fx: Cold ember. A brand shed this on the way up and they left it.

torch_sill.name: Torch Sill
torch_sill.desc: A charred sill south of the rest. Resin is packed in a crack.

actions.label: pinch the resin
fx: Hard resin. They daubed the brands here and left the lump.

torch_lip.name: Torch Lip
torch_lip.desc: A charred lip north of the rest. Char is packed in a crack.

actions.label: pinch the char
fx: Cold char. A brand shed this and they left it.

torch_nook.name: Torch Nook
torch_nook.desc: A charred pocket west of the rest. A cinder is packed in a crack.

actions.label: pinch the cinder
fx: Cold cinder. A brand broke here and they left the bit.

ledge.name: Lookout Ledge
ledge.desc: A slab of rock facing the reef. Boot-scuffs in the lichen.

actions.label: trace the boot-scuffs
fx: A heel toward the pit. Someone ran here with the torch.

spy_notch.name: Spy Notch
spy_notch.desc: A notch in the rock where a glass once sat. The lichen is worn.

actions.label: wipe the lichen
fx: The reef lines up. Someone watched from here, not the gallery.

glass_rest.name: Glass Rest
glass_rest.desc: A worn groove in the rock. Rain sits in it.

actions.label: dip a finger
fx: Salt, not rain. Spray from the reef.

spray_cup.name: Spray Cup
spray_cup.desc: A hollow in the rock that holds spray. A shell is stuck to the rim.

actions.label: prise the shell
fx: It comes. Empty. The spray filled it, not a creature.

kelp_mat.name: Kelp Mat
kelp_mat.desc: A mat of dried kelp. One holdfast still grips the rock.

actions.label: tug the holdfast
fx: It tears. The kelp rode the last spring tide.

wrack_line.name: Wrack Line
wrack_line.desc: A wrack line on the rock. One cork is painted red.

actions.label: pick the cork
fx: Channel red. Someone marked the inner passage from here.

barnacle.name: Barnacle Plate
barnacle.desc: A plate of barnacles on the wrack rock. One is hollow.

actions.label: crack a barnacle
fx: Empty. The spray scoured it, not a meal.

lighthouse_base.name: Lighthouse Door
lighthouse_base.desc: The tower's base, iron-banded oak door streaked with salt. Above, the lamp room stands dark against the running clouds.

in.lockedMsg: The iron lock holds fast. You need the keeper's key.

actions.label: sound the foghorn
fx: A low blast rolls over the water.

actions.label: knock on the oak door
fx: No answer but the wind in the keyhole.

door_lintel.name: Door Lintel
door_lintel.desc: Stone over the oak door. Grit is packed in a crack.

actions.label: scrape the lintel
fx: Dry grit. Wind packed it into the crack.

door_sill.name: Door Sill
door_sill.desc: The north sill of the oak door. Salt is packed in a crack.

door_hinge.name: Door Hinge
door_hinge.desc: The west strap-hinge. One pin sits proud of the barrel.

actions.label: ease the pin
fx: It seats. The door will still take the key.

door_stud.name: Door Stud
door_stud.desc: A bronze stud in the oak, meant for a knocker that never arrived.

actions.label: press the stud
fx: It clicks. Nothing behind it but the grain.

lean_to.name: Lamp Lean-to
lean_to.desc: A salt-stained shed against the tower. Spare chimneys; a dry wick in a tin.

actions.label: fit a spare chimney
fx: The glass seats. It will not smoke when you light her.

spare_flue.name: Spare Flue
spare_flue.desc: A spare flue-pipe under the floor. One dent in the tin.

actions.label: rattle the flue
fx: Empty. She never needed the spare.

vent_flap.name: Vent Flap
vent_flap.desc: A tin flap in the lean-to roof. Rusted open. Rain stains below.

actions.label: seat the flap
fx: It sticks. The rain will still come in.

wick_tin.name: Wick Tin
wick_tin.desc: A dented tin of spare wicks on the south shelf. The lid is jammed.

actions.label: prise the lid
fx: It pops. One dry wick. Enough for a night.

soot_brush.name: Soot Brush
soot_brush.desc: A hog-bristle brush hung on a nail. Last week's glass, still black.

actions.label: knock the soot
fx: Black on your cuff. Last week's glass, not tonight's.

bunker.name: Coal Bunker
bunker.desc: Wet slack coal. A shovel stands in the heap.

actions.label: bank the coal
fx: You heap it so the rain will not drown a fire.

bunker_sump.name: Bunker Sump
bunker_sump.desc: A shallow sump under the bunker. Black water, one lump.

actions.label: stir the sump
fx: The lump is clinker. The drain still works.

coal_hatch.name: Coal Hatch
coal_hatch.desc: A roof hatch over the bunker. The bolt is rusted shut.

actions.label: throw the bolt
fx: It gives. Grey sky. No coal has come this way.

coal_slide.name: Coal Slide
coal_slide.desc: A wooden slide on the west wall. Dust in the groove, no coal in it.

actions.label: work the slide
fx: It judders. Nothing left to send down.

shovel_haft.name: Shovel Haft
shovel_haft.desc: The bunker's spare haft, split and bound with wire.

actions.label: grip the haft
fx: The wire bites. She bound it after the last wet winter.

chute.name: Coal Chute
chute.desc: A tin slide into the bunker. Rain ticks on the metal.

actions.label: rattle the chute
fx: Empty. The last sack went down years ago.

chute_pan.name: Chute Pan
chute_pan.desc: A catch-pan under the chute. One lump of wet slack.

actions.label: scrape the pan
fx: Clinker. The rest went into the bunker.

chute_collar.name: Chute Collar
chute_collar.desc: A tin collar at the chute's top. One dent in the rim.

actions.label: tap the collar
fx: It rings. Empty all the way down.

slack_heap.name: Slack Heap
slack_heap.desc: A wet pile of slack on the west side of the chute. One lump is still hard.

actions.label: kick the slack
fx: It cakes. Rain, not coal, made this heap.

chute_rung.name: Chute Rung
chute_rung.desc: An iron rung on the east wall of the chute. Cold. One rivet is loose.

actions.label: grip the rung
fx: It holds. She used it to climb when the slide jammed.

hopper.name: Coal Hopper
hopper.desc: A wooden hopper over the chute. One board is split.

actions.label: press the split board
fx: It flexes. The hopper is empty of coal.

hopper_boot.name: Hopper Boot
hopper_boot.desc: The hopper's floor-boot. Dust packed in the seam.

actions.label: pack the seam
fx: It holds. No coal has come through in years.

hopper_lid.name: Hopper Lid
hopper_lid.desc: A wooden lid on the hopper's top. One hinge is loose.

actions.label: seat the lid
fx: It sits. The last load went down years ago.

clinker_tray.name: Clinker Tray
clinker_tray.desc: A tin tray under the hopper's east lip. Grey clinker, one lump.

actions.label: shake the tray
fx: Dust. The last coal burned years ago.

coal_gate.name: Coal Gate
coal_gate.desc: A wooden gate on the hopper's west side. The latch is jammed with dust.

actions.label: ease the gate
fx: It scrapes an inch. No coal waits behind it.

sack_bay.name: Sack Bay
sack_bay.desc: Empty coal sacks, stiff with dust. One still has a stitch.

actions.label: pull the stitch
fx: It holds. The sack is too rotten to fill.

sack_pit.name: Sack Pit
sack_pit.desc: A pit under the bay. Coal dust, no lump.

actions.label: rake the dust
fx: Fine grit. She never filled another.

sack_loft.name: Sack Loft
sack_loft.desc: A loft over the sacks. Spare twine on a peg.

actions.label: knot the twine
fx: It holds. She never sewed the last sack.

tally_board.name: Tally Board
tally_board.desc: A tally-board on the north wall. Three notches, then blank.

actions.label: score the tally
fx: Three sacks. April '81. Same as the ledger.

sack_hook.name: Sack Hook
sack_hook.desc: An iron hook on the west post. Empty. Rust in the eye.

actions.label: test the hook
fx: It holds. The last sack went down the chute.

weigh_house.name: Weigh House
weigh_house.desc: A rusted platform scale. The needle is stuck at zero.

actions.label: nudge the needle
fx: It jumps, then dies. No coal has come through here in years.

scale_pan.name: Scale Pan
scale_pan.desc: The spare pan under the scale. One dent in the rim.

actions.label: thumb the dent
fx: Old dent. The last sack never sat.

weigh_loft.name: Weigh Loft
weigh_loft.desc: A trap above the scale. Pencil dates on the beam.

actions.label: trace a date
fx: April '81. The last load. Then nothing.

ticket_spike.name: Ticket Spike
ticket_spike.desc: A spike on the south desk. One weigh-ticket, faded.

actions.label: pull the ticket
fx: April '81. Three sacks. Same as the ledger.

scale_weight.name: Scale Weight
scale_weight.desc: A 56-pound weight on the north pan. Dust in the ring.

actions.label: lift the weight
fx: It comes. The pan stays down. The scale is dead.

ledger_nook.name: Ledger Nook
ledger_nook.desc: A desk and a coal ledger, the last page torn.

ledger_bin.name: Ledger Bin
ledger_bin.desc: A bin under the desk. Torn scraps, no date.

actions.label: stir the scraps
fx: Blank. She tore the last page clean.

ledger_loft.name: Ledger Loft
ledger_loft.desc: A trap over the desk. Pencil dates on the joist.

actions.label: rap the joist
fx: Hollow. She hid nothing up here.

pencil_box.name: Pencil Box
pencil_box.desc: A pencil-box on the south shelf. One stub, no lead.

actions.label: twirl the stub
fx: No lead. She wrote the last page in ink.

stamp_pad.name: Stamp Pad
stamp_pad.desc: A dried ink-pad on the north shelf. One rubber stamp, uninked.

actions.label: press the pad
fx: Dust. The last stamp was April '81.

inkwell.name: Inkwell
inkwell.desc: A dry inkwell and a chewed pen. The nib is split.

actions.label: test the nib
fx: It catches. Whoever last wrote here was in a hurry.

ink_dregs.name: Ink Dregs
ink_dregs.desc: A cup under the well. Dried dregs, no black.

actions.label: scrape the dregs
fx: Dry. She wrote the last page with what was left.

pen_rest.name: Pen Rest
pen_rest.desc: A south cubby. One spare pen, unused, no nib.

actions.label: roll the pen
fx: No nib. She wrote with the split one.

nib_box.name: Nib Box
nib_box.desc: A tin of spare nibs on the high shelf. One is unused.

actions.label: sort the nibs
fx: Split, same as the pen. She never replaced it.

pounce_pot.name: Pounce Pot
pounce_pot.desc: A tin pounce-pot in the north cubby. Lid ajar. Fine sand on the rim.

actions.label: sift the pounce
fx: Fine grit. She sanded the last page dry.

blotter.name: Blotter
blotter.desc: A stained blotter stuck to the desk. One corner is free.

actions.label: peel the blotter
fx: April rain. The ink ran. The last entry is gone.

blot_press.name: Blot Press
blot_press.desc: A press under the desk. One unused sheet, folded.

actions.label: work the screw
fx: Tight. She never put a new sheet in.

blot_shelf.name: Blot Shelf
blot_shelf.desc: A high shelf over the blotter. One spare sheet, unused.

actions.label: slide the sheet
fx: Clean. She never put a new blotter down.

letter_knife.name: Letter Knife
letter_knife.desc: A letter-knife in the south drawer. The edge is dull.

actions.label: hone the edge
fx: It takes no edge. She opened the last letter with it.

sealing_wax.name: Sealing Wax
sealing_wax.desc: A stick of sealing-wax on the north edge. Unlit. One nick.

actions.label: nick the stick
fx: April '81. The last letter never went.

sand_shaker.name: Sand Shaker
sand_shaker.desc: A brass sand-shaker on its side. The cap is loose.

actions.label: tip the shaker
fx: Dry sand. She stopped blotting when the rain came in.

stair.name: Spiral Stair
stair.desc: Stone steps corkscrew up into the tower. An oil store opens off the landing east; the lamp room is up.

actions.label: brace the loose rail
fx: The rail holds. Someone will need it coming down.

stair_lip.name: Stair Lip
stair_lip.desc: A stone lip north of the landing. Mortar is packed in a crack.

actions.label: pinch the mortar
fx: Dry mortar. They pointed this after the last freeze.

stair_sump.name: Stair Sump
stair_sump.desc: A drain under the landing. Loose stone is packed in a crack.

actions.label: pinch the stone
fx: Loose stone. They packed this after a tread broke.

stair_sill.name: Stair Sill
stair_sill.desc: A stone sill south of the landing. Grit is packed in a tread.

actions.label: scrape the grit
fx: Dry grit. Boots tracked it up from the door.

key_hook.name: Key Hook
key_hook.desc: An empty iron hook on the landing. The keeper's key hung here.

actions.label: feel the hook
fx: Cold. Empty. She took the key down to the cottage.

hook_sump.name: Hook Sump
hook_sump.desc: A dry drain under the hook. A spare barb is packed in a crack.

actions.label: pinch the barb
fx: Iron barb. They meant to hang a new hook and left it.

hook_ridge.name: Hook Ridge
hook_ridge.desc: A dry ridge above the hook. A spare collar is packed in a crack.

actions.label: pinch the collar
fx: Iron collar. They meant to seat a new hook and left it.

hook_sill.name: Hook Sill
hook_sill.desc: A dry sill south of the hook. A spare shank is packed in a crack.

actions.label: pinch the shank
fx: Iron shank. They meant to replace the empty hook and left it.

hook_lip.name: Hook Lip
hook_lip.desc: A dry lip north of the hook. A key ring is packed in a crack.

actions.label: pinch the ring
fx: Iron ring. The key hung through this and they left it.

iron_lip.name: Iron Lip
iron_lip.desc: A dry lip north of the nook. Iron crust is packed in a crack.

actions.label: pinch the crust
fx: Hard crust. The key sat wet here and they left the flake.

iron_sill.name: Iron Sill
iron_sill.desc: A dry sill south of the nook. An iron speck is packed in a crack.

actions.label: pinch the speck
fx: Iron speck. The key sat wet here and they left this bit.

iron_nook.name: Iron Nook
iron_nook.desc: A dry pocket west of the hook nook. Iron filings are packed in a crack.

actions.label: pinch the filings
fx: Iron filings. The key sat wet here and they packed this.

iron_ridge.name: Iron Ridge
iron_ridge.desc: A dry ridge above the nook. Iron bits are packed in a crack.

actions.label: pinch the bits
fx: Iron bits. The hook shed these and they packed them.

hook_nook.name: Hook Nook
hook_nook.desc: A dry pocket west of the hook. Iron scale is packed in a crack.

actions.label: pinch the iron
fx: Thin scale. The key sat here wet and they left the mark.

iron_sump.name: Iron Sump
iron_sump.desc: A dry sump under the nook. Iron slivers are packed in a crack.

actions.label: pinch the sliver
fx: Iron sliver. The hook shed this and it packed in the crack.

oil_store.name: Oil Store
oil_store.desc: Casks and coiled chain. The air is cold in a way that has nothing to do with the sea.

actions.label: search the casks
fx: A spare wick, already oiled. You leave it.

actions.label: lash the loose chain
fx: The chain stops its dead ringing.

oil_ridge.name: Oil Ridge
oil_ridge.desc: Rafters over the casks. A bung is packed in a crack.

actions.label: pinch the bung
fx: Dry bung. They drove it in after a cask wept.

oil_lip.name: Oil Lip
oil_lip.desc: A stone lip north of the casks. A stave is packed in a crack.

actions.label: pinch the stave
fx: Dry oak. They wedged this stave after the hoop slipped.

oil_sill.name: Oil Sill
oil_sill.desc: A stone sill south of the casks. A hoop is packed in a crack.

actions.label: pinch the hoop
fx: Iron hoop. They drove it in to keep a stave from springing.

oil_sump.name: Oil Sump
oil_sump.desc: A drain under the casks. Oil is packed in a drip.

actions.label: pinch the drip
fx: Thick oil. A cask wept here and they left it.

chain_hook.name: Chain Hook
chain_hook.desc: A wall hook behind the casks. One loose link still hangs from the wight's pull.

actions.label: hang a link
fx: It takes. The wight had pulled this free in the dark.

chain_sump.name: Chain Sump
chain_sump.desc: A dry drain under the hook. A spare spike is packed in a crack.

actions.label: pinch the spike
fx: Iron spike. They meant to pin the hook to the wall and left it.

chain_ridge.name: Chain Ridge
chain_ridge.desc: A dry ridge above the hook. A spare staple is packed in a crack.

actions.label: pinch the staple
fx: Iron staple. They meant to pin the hook back and left it.

chain_stoop.name: Chain Stoop
chain_stoop.desc: A dry stoop south of the hook. A weld bead is packed in a crack.

actions.label: pinch the weld
fx: Iron bead. They meant to mend the pulled link and left it.

chain_lip.name: Chain Lip
chain_lip.desc: A dry lip north of the hook. A spare shackle is packed in a crack.

actions.label: pinch the shackle
fx: Iron shackle. They meant to pin the loose link and left it.

link_lip.name: Link Lip
link_lip.desc: A dry lip north of the sill. A spare pin is packed in a crack.

actions.label: pinch the pin
fx: Iron pin. They meant to join a spare link and left it.

link_sill.name: Link Sill
link_sill.desc: A dry sill south of the spare-link sill. A clip is packed in a crack.

actions.label: pinch the clip
fx: Iron clip. They meant to hold a spare link and left it.

link_nook.name: Link Nook
link_nook.desc: A dry pocket east of the sill. A spare catch is packed in a crack.

actions.label: pinch the catch
fx: Iron catch. They meant to close a spare link and left it.

chain_sill.name: Chain Sill
chain_sill.desc: A stone sill east of the hook. A spare link is packed in a crack.

actions.label: pinch the link
fx: Iron link. They kept a spare after the wight pulled one free.

link_ridge.name: Link Ridge
link_ridge.desc: A dry ridge above the sill. A cotter is packed in a crack.

actions.label: pinch the cotter
fx: Iron cotter. They meant to pin a spare link and left it.

link_sump.name: Link Sump
link_sump.desc: A dry sump under the sill. A split link is packed in a crack.

actions.label: pinch the split
fx: Split link. They meant to join it and left it.

lamp_room.name: Lamp Room
lamp_room.desc: The great mirrored lamp, cold and still. Its winding mechanism is orange with rust. The whole coast lies black below.

actions.label: oil the mechanism with the flask
fx: The flask empties into the gears; they turn free.
Oil spatters the rust. The flask is still in your hand; the gears stay seized.

actions.label: polish the brass
fx: The fittings take a dull shine.

actions.label: wipe the lamp mirrors
fx: Salt film comes off. The glass will throw a true beam.

actions.label: light the beacon
fx: Flame takes the wick; mirrors catch it and hurl it out to sea. The beam sweeps the reef, and far out in the dark a ship leans away to safety.

lamp_ridge.name: Lamp Ridge
lamp_ridge.desc: Rafters over the lamp. A spare wick is packed in a crack.

actions.label: pinch the wick
fx: Oiled wick. They stuffed it here against a dark night.

lamp_lip.name: Lamp Lip
lamp_lip.desc: A brass lip north of the lamp. Soot is packed in a seam.

actions.label: pinch the soot
fx: Dry soot. The last keeper wiped the glass and left this.

lamp_sill.name: Lamp Sill
lamp_sill.desc: A brass sill south of the lamp. Film is packed in a seam.

actions.label: pinch the film
fx: Salt film. Spray drove it into the seam.

lamp_nook.name: Lamp Nook
lamp_nook.desc: A dry pocket behind the glass. One flange is packed with rust.

actions.label: scrape the rust
fx: Orange scale. They oiled the gears and left the flange to seize.

rust_sump.name: Rust Sump
rust_sump.desc: A dry drain under the nook. Rust powder is packed in a seam.

actions.label: pinch the powder
fx: Orange powder. Scale fell from the flange and they left it.

rust_ridge.name: Rust Ridge
rust_ridge.desc: A dry ridge above the nook. A rust stain is packed in a seam.

actions.label: pinch the stain
fx: Orange stain. Spray ran up the flange and they left it.

salt_lip.name: Salt Lip
salt_lip.desc: A dry lip east of the sill. Salt is packed in a seam.

actions.label: pinch the salt
fx: Dry salt. Spray sat on the sill and they left it.

rust_sill.name: Rust Sill
rust_sill.desc: A dry sill south of the nook. A rust smear is packed in a seam.

actions.label: pinch the smear
fx: Orange smear. They wiped the flange here and left the mark.

salt_sill.name: Salt Sill
salt_sill.desc: A dry sill south of the rust sill. Salt grain is packed in a seam.

actions.label: pinch the grain
fx: Dry salt grain. Spray dried here and they packed it.

salt_nook.name: Salt Nook
salt_nook.desc: A dry pocket west of the rust sill. A salt lump is packed in a seam.

actions.label: pinch the lump
fx: Dry salt lump. Spray sat in the pocket and they left it.

salt_ridge.name: Salt Ridge
salt_ridge.desc: A dry ridge above the rust sill. Salt cake is packed in a crack.

actions.label: pinch the cake
fx: Dry salt cake. Spray dried on the ridge and they left it.

salt_sump.name: Salt Sump
salt_sump.desc: A dry sump under the rust sill. Salt rime is packed in a crack.

actions.label: pinch the rime
fx: Dry salt rime. Spray sat in the sump and they left it.

rust_nook.name: Rust Nook
rust_nook.desc: A dry pocket north of the nook. A flange flake is packed in a seam.

actions.label: pinch the flange
fx: Brass flake. They left this after the flange seized.

rust_ledge.name: Rust Ledge
rust_ledge.desc: A dry ledge above the nook. A rust pit is packed in a crack.

actions.label: pinch the pit
fx: Deep pit. Water sat in the iron and they packed it here.

rust_shelf.name: Rust Shelf
rust_shelf.desc: A dry shelf north of the nook. A rust curl is packed in a crack.

actions.label: pinch the curl
fx: Hard curl. Spray lifted the iron and they packed it here.

rust_well.name: Rust Well
rust_well.desc: A dry well below the nook. Rust skin is packed in a crack.

actions.label: pinch the skin
fx: Hard skin. Spray lifted a sheet of rust and they packed it here.

flange_lip.name: Flange Lip
flange_lip.desc: A dry lip east of the nook. A brass flake is packed in a seam.

actions.label: pinch the brass
fx: Brass flake. The flange shed this and they packed it here.

flange_nook.name: Flange Nook
flange_nook.desc: A dry pocket west of the rust nook. A washer is packed in a seam.

actions.label: pinch the washer
fx: Iron washer. They meant to seat the flange and left it.

oxide_lip.name: Oxide Lip
oxide_lip.desc: A dry lip north of the rust lip. Oxide bloom is packed in a seam.

actions.label: pinch the bloom
fx: Orange bloom. Spray sat on the brass and they left it.

oxide_nook.name: Oxide Nook
oxide_nook.desc: A dry pocket west of the lip. Oxide rind is packed in a seam.

actions.label: pinch the rind
fx: Hard oxide rind. It came off the brass and they packed it here.

oxide_ridge.name: Oxide Ridge
oxide_ridge.desc: A dry ridge above the lip. Oxide scar is packed in a crack.

actions.label: pinch the scar
fx: Hard oxide scar. Spray sat on the brass and they packed it here.

oxide_sill.name: Oxide Sill
oxide_sill.desc: A dry sill south of the rust lip. Oxide scab is packed in a seam.

actions.label: pinch the scab
fx: Hard scab. It came off the lip and they packed it here.

oxide_sump.name: Oxide Sump
oxide_sump.desc: A dry sump below the sill. Oxide pock is packed in a crack.

actions.label: pinch the pock
fx: Hard pock. Spray ate the iron and they packed it here.

oxide_stoop.name: Oxide Stoop
oxide_stoop.desc: A dry stoop east of the sill. An oxide clod is packed in a crack.

actions.label: pinch the clod
fx: Hard clod. It broke off the sill and they packed it here.

oxide_bay.name: Oxide Bay
oxide_bay.desc: A dry bay west of the sill. Oxide peel is packed in a crack.

actions.label: pinch the peel
fx: Thin peel. Spray lifted it off the iron and they packed it here.

oxide_step.name: Oxide Step
oxide_step.desc: A dry step south of the sill. Oxide clay is packed in a crack.

actions.label: pinch the clay
fx: Hard clay. Spray mixed it with rust and they packed it here.

oxide_hood.name: Oxide Hood
oxide_hood.desc: A dry hood above the sill. Oxide lime is packed in a crack.

actions.label: pinch the lime
fx: Hard lime. Spray left a white crust and they packed it here.

rust_lip.name: Rust Lip
rust_lip.desc: A dry lip east of the nook. Oxide is packed in a seam.

actions.label: pinch the oxide
fx: Dry oxide. Spray got in the seam and they left it.

rust_stoop.name: Rust Stoop
rust_stoop.desc: A dry stoop east of the lip. Rust is packed in a crack.

actions.label: pinch the rust
fx: Hard rust. Spray sat on the lip and they packed it here.

rust_pit.name: Rust Pit
rust_pit.desc: A dry pit under the stoop. A rust patch is packed in a crack.

actions.label: pinch the patch
fx: Dry patch. Spray pooled under the stoop and they packed it here.

rust_post.name: Rust Post
rust_post.desc: A dry post north of the rail. A rust dash is packed in a crack.

actions.label: pinch the dash
fx: Thin dash. Spray marked the post and they packed it here.

rust_horn.name: Rust Horn
rust_horn.desc: A dry horn east of the post. Packed rust forms a horn.

actions.label: pinch the horn
fx: Hard horn. Spray grew it on the post and they packed it here.

rust_loop.name: Rust Loop
rust_loop.desc: A dry loop north of the horn. Packed rust forms a loop.

actions.label: pinch the loop
fx: Tight loop. They bent it off the horn and packed it here.

rust_mill.name: Rust Mill
rust_mill.desc: A dry mill east of the loop. Packed rust is mill scale.

actions.label: pinch the mill
fx: Hard mill. It scaled off the loop and they packed it here.

rust_lath.name: Rust Lath
rust_lath.desc: A dry lath south of the mill. Packed rust coats a lath.

actions.label: pinch the lath
fx: Thin lath. They nailed it under the mill and packed rust around it.

rust_hasp.name: Rust Hasp
rust_hasp.desc: A dry hasp east of the lath. Packed rust coats a hasp.

actions.label: pinch the hasp
fx: Bent hasp. They hinged it on the lath and packed rust around it.

topics.label: the dark tower
topics.say: Old Maren kept that light forty years. Her cottage is just north — and she never parted with the key, not even dead. Go gentle if you go.

topics.label: a sailor's tale
topics.say: They say the thing in the oil store came off a wreck in '09. Take iron if you go up there.

topics.label: farewell
topics.say: Mind the stair. And light it, lad.

topics.label: the iron key
topics.say: You spoke to Aldun first. Good. Take it — and take my lantern. Light her one last time.
fx: Cold iron presses into your palm.

topics.label: her lighthouse
topics.say: Forty winters I climbed those stairs. The gears want oil; the store keeps it. Mind what the store keeps besides.

topics.label: the brig in the surf
topics.say: We saw no light. Fire a flare from the stair if you have one.

topics.label: the wreck of '09
topics.say: That wight came off the brig. Iron bites it. Don't go up dark.

topics.label: Maren's watch
topics.say: She never missed a night. Wipe the glass if you climb — salt blinds the beam.

sea_wight.name: sea-wight
onDeath: The wight collapses into brine and weed. Behind where it stood: an oil flask.
